name: Haughwout passenger safety elevator
description: A passenger elevator with a safety device was installed in a New York commercial building.

places.note: Modern country or region reference, not a claim about historical boundaries.

date.basis: Date stated in the cited source.

events.statement: An Otis passenger elevator installation was completed at the Haughwout store in New York.
events.caveats: HABS dates shipment to 23 March; other accounts call that the service start. Installation completion is not proof of the first ride.

evidence.supports: An Otis passenger elevator installation was completed at the Haughwout store in New York.
Otis states 23 March 1857 as entry into service, unlike the HABS ledger account’s shipment date and 6 April completion.
HABS attributes the elevator to Otis and cites his ledgers.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest sourced event establishing the capability in this record; earlier funding need not imply deployment.

caveats: Earlier hoists and freight safety devices existed; service start and fares remain open.

research.note: Initial evidence-backed admission; historical interpretations await independent review. Independent reader checked dated events against cited sources, and links and measures where marked; Otis and HABS provide different elevator chronologies.
